findings.current: I stared at the very familiar-looking ring in silence, then broke it.
findings.defect: “Broke it” reads as though Taekyung physically breaks the ring, contradicting the ensuing exchange.
findings.rationale: The next line is Taekyung speaking, not damaging the ring.
findings.replacement: I stared at the very familiar-looking ring in silence, then broke the silence.
findings.source: Chapter 936, Taekyung notices the Divine Physician holding the ring

findings.current: he’s been an idiot then and now.
findings.defect: The tense does not work with “then and now.”
findings.rationale: This keeps Jeok’s blunt judgment while making the time contrast natural English.
findings.replacement: he was an idiot then, and he still is.
findings.source: Chapter 938, Jeok Cheongang recalls the Thunderbolt Saber King

findings.current: mare’s-milk wine made by milking and boiling horses alongside his followers
findings.defect: The phrasing says the horses, rather than their milk, were boiled.
findings.rationale: This preserves the stated preparation steps without the unintended physical action.
findings.replacement: mare’s-milk wine made by milking mares and boiling the milk alongside his followers
findings.source: Chapter 939, Temur reflects on his former life

summary: The packet’s continuity and terminology are largely consistent. Three reading-copy phrases need correction; one mistakenly implies that Taekyung breaks the Myriad-Poison Ring.
